---
title: Chart data cells
---

```chart
type: line
title: '<script>HOSTILE_LINE_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { t: 2024-01-01, v: 1, g: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>' }
    - { t: 2024-02-01, v: 2, g: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>' }
    - { t: 2024-01-01, v: 2, g: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>' }
    - { t: 2024-02-01, v: 3, g: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>' }
encoding: { x: t, y: v, color: g }
```

```chart
type: area
title: '<script>HOSTILE_AREA_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { t: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', v: 1 }
    - { t: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', v: 2 }
encoding: { x: t, y: v }
```

```chart
type: scatter
title: '<script>HOSTILE_SCATTER_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { a: 1, b: 2, n: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', s: 1 }
    - { a: 2, b: 3, n: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', s: 2 }
encoding: { x: a, y: b, label: n, size: s, color: n }
highlight: {by: n, include: ['<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_HL()>']}
```

```chart
type: pie
title: '<script>HOSTILE_PIE_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { k: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', v: 1 }
    - { k: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', v: 2 }
encoding: { x: k, y: v }
```

```chart
type: heatmap
title: '<script>HOSTILE_HEATMAP_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { r: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', c: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', v: 1 }
    - { r: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', c: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', v: 2 }
encoding: { x: c, y: r, color: v }
```

```chart
type: histogram
title: '<script>HOSTILE_HISTOGRAM_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { v: 1 }
    - { v: 2 }
    - { v: 3 }
encoding: { x: v }
axes: { x: { label: '<script>HOSTILE_HIST()</script>' } }
```

```chart
type: boxplot
title: '<script>HOSTILE_BOXPLOT_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { g: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', v: 1 }
    - { g: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', v: 2 }
    - { g: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', v: 3 }
    - { g: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', v: 2 }
    - { g: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', v: 4 }
encoding: { x: g, y: v }
```

```chart
type: interval
title: '<script>HOSTILE_INTERVAL_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { g: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>', lo: 1, hi: 3, m: 2 }
    - { g: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>', lo: 2, hi: 4, m: 3 }
encoding: { x: g, y: m, lower: lo, upper: hi }
```

```chart
type: bar
title: '<script>HOSTILE_BAR_TITLE()</script>'
data:
  inline:
    - { x: A, y: 1, f: '<img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_CAT()>' }
    - { x: B, y: 2, f: '"><script>HOSTILE_SER()</script>' }
encoding: { x: x, y: y, facet: f }
```
